roadmap.title: Campaign and manuscripts
roadmap.description: Complete all three campaign acts while collecting the 53 manuscript pages and performing the Splitter shotgun kill in Act 2. Finished chapters remain available for cleanup.

roadmap.title: Normal Arcade challenges
roadmap.description: Earn three stars on all five Normal stages, survive one stage using only the flashlight and handheld flares, and complete the six-minute 100,000-point streak on Normal Oil Field.

roadmap.title: Nightmare Arcade completion
roadmap.description: Earn nine more stars across the first four Nightmare stages to reach 24 total, then score 70,000 points in a Nightmare stage.

roadmap.title: Taken cleanup
roadmap.description: Finish the cumulative 2,000-Taken requirement only after the campaign and Arcade objectives have contributed their natural kills.

achievements.displayName: Escape the Taken to the motel.
achievements.description: You reached the relative safety of the motel.
achievements.summary: In @loc{Act 1: The Mechanic}, escape the opening @enemy{Taken} wave and reach the lit entrance to the Motel.

guide.context: This is the first mandatory campaign unlock and can be earned on any difficulty.

steps.text: After the opening fight, obey the prompt to run from the @enemy{Taken}, enter the checkpoint light at the Motel compound, and continue toward the marked garage objective until the achievement unlocks.

achievements.displayName: Rewrite reality for the first time.
achievements.description: You rewrote reality and brought down the satellite.
achievements.summary: In @loc{Act 1: The Mechanic}, collect the three marked objects and complete the satellite rewrite at the Motel.

guide.context: The map marks all three required objects after Alan investigates the garage and speaks with Emma.

steps.text: Investigate the Motel garage, speak with @npc{Emma}, and collect the three rewriting objects shown on the map.
Return to the rewrite site, insert the @item{CD} into the boombox, attach and turn the @item{valve} in front of the oil, then install the @item{battery} in the switch and turn the switch on.
Allow the resulting satellite event to finish; the first successful reality rewrite awards the achievement.

achievements.displayName: Make sure Dr. Meadows can take another look at the skies.
achievements.description: You secured the coolant tanks at the observatory.
achievements.summary: In @loc{Act 2: Progress}, use the grey control-box switch at the lower observatory to secure the coolant tanks.

guide.context: This objective appears after Alan meets Dr. Meadows for the second time and is mandatory story progress.

steps.text: Follow the objective to the fenced coolant-tank area beside the secondary, lower observatory and approach the grey control box.
Use the switch on the control box to secure the coolant tanks and complete the objective; the achievement unlocks immediately.

achievements.displayName: Rewrite reality for the last time.
achievements.description: You used Mr. Scratch’s own trap to destroy him.
achievements.summary: Complete the final reality rewrite in @loc{Act 3: United} and let Mr. Scratch’s trap destroy him.

guide.context: The achievement is tied to the mandatory final scene. Watching the entire credits reveals an extra scene but is not required for the unlock.

steps.text: Complete every objective in @loc{Act 3: United}, perform the final rewrite, and watch the scene in which Alan turns @npc{Mr. Scratch}'s trap against him.

achievements.displayName: Survive until dawn in any Arcade Mode level.
achievements.description: You made it through the night and enjoyed a nice sunrise in one of the Arcade levels.
achievements.sortReason: Combine with the restricted Ghost Town survival run.
achievements.summary: Remain alive until the 10-minute timer reaches sunrise in any @loc{Arcade Mode} stage.

guide.context: Sunrise ends the round and destroys every surviving Taken. This can be combined with the flashlight-and-flares-only achievement on Normal Ghost Town.

steps.text: Start any Normal or Nightmare Arcade stage; choose @loc{Normal Ghost Town} if you also need the restricted-equipment survival achievement.
Avoid or defeat the @enemy{Taken} until the full 10-minute timer expires and sunrise ends the round.

achievements.displayName: Get a six-minute survivor streak and over 100,000 points in an Arcade level.
achievements.description: You got a six-minute survivor streak and over 100,000 points in an Arcade level.
achievements.sortReason: Attempt on Normal Oil Field while earning Normal stars.
achievements.summary: In one @loc{Arcade Mode} run, take no damage for at least six minutes and reach 100,000 points before that streak ends.

guide.context: The score may cross 100,000 after the sixth minute, but Alan must remain undamaged from the start of the qualifying streak until the score requirement is met. A hit, push, or nearby grenade also resets the score multiplier.

steps.text: Start @loc{Normal Oil Field}, collect the @item{Magnum} beside the giant silos to the south, and collect the @item{Combat Shotgun} from the suitcase by the small building east of the main turret and ammunition box.
Use early cinematic dodges and safe kills to build the @mechanic{score multiplier} toward 6x or 7x without taking damage.
Kill efficiently while preserving the no-damage streak, and prioritize @enemy{Grenadiers} so their explosives cannot end the attempt.
Continue until the no-damage timer has exceeded six minutes and the score reaches 100,000 during that same uninterrupted survivor streak; the achievement appears as soon as both conditions are true.

achievements.displayName: Unlock all of the Nightmare Arcade Mode levels.
achievements.description: You have unlocked all of the Nightmare Arcade Mode levels.
achievements.sortReason: Build to 24 stars after completing the Normal-stage challenges.
achievements.summary: Earn 24 total @mechanic{Arcade stars} to unlock all five Nightmare versions of the Arcade stages.

guide.context: Arcade Mode contains Normal and Nightmare versions of Cemetery, Ghost Town, Oil Field, Caves, and Trailer Park. Sunrise kills still award points, and a round need not be survived once its target score has already been secured.

steps.text: Score at least 40,000 points on each of the five Normal stages to earn three stars per stage and reach 15 total stars.
Across the first four unlocked Nightmare stages, earn nine more stars; 25,000 points awards two stars and 50,000 points awards three stars on a Nightmare stage.
Reach 24 cumulative stars to unlock the last Nightmare stage and receive the achievement.

achievements.displayName: Survive an Arcade level using nothing but the flashlight and handheld flares.
achievements.description: You survived an Arcade level using nothing but the flashlight and handheld flares.
achievements.sortReason: Use Normal Ghost Town and combine with the generic dawn survival.
achievements.summary: Survive all 10 minutes of an @loc{Arcade Mode} stage using only the flashlight and handheld flares.

guide.context: Do not fire any gun and do not use flashbangs. The roof edge in Normal Ghost Town lets Alan avoid most enemies while still satisfying the equipment restriction.

steps.text: Start @loc{Normal Ghost Town}, move left and then right to the wooden stairs, and do not fire a weapon or use a flashbang at any time.
Run and jump onto the upper stair handrail, then jump northeast onto the roof edge and move east to its stable section.
Keep the movement control aimed north to prevent Alan from sliding off, using only the @item{flashlight} and @item{handheld flares} if enemies approach.
Remain alive on the roof edge until the 10-minute timer ends at sunrise; this run also awards the generic dawn-survival achievement if it is still locked.

achievements.displayName: Get 70,000 points in any Nightmare Arcade level.
achievements.description: You got 70,000 points in a Nightmare Arcade level.
achievements.sortReason: Complete after a Nightmare stage has been unlocked.
achievements.summary: Build a 70,000-point total on a Nightmare Arcade stage; @loc{Nightmare Oil Field} offers a defensible rock position.

guide.context: Deaths caused by Grenadier Taken and the final sunrise still add to the score, so either can push the total across 70,000 without Alan firing the finishing shot.

steps.text: Reach 24 @mechanic{Arcade stars} to unlock every Nightmare stage, then start @loc{Nightmare Oil Field}.
From the center of the arena, look right, move behind the house on the left side, and climb onto the nearby rock.
Attack safely from the rock and allow @enemy{Grenadiers} to damage clustered Taken when possible, preserving the multiplier while working toward 70,000 points.
Reach 70,000 before the run ends, or remain alive with enough Taken present for their sunrise deaths to carry the score past the threshold.

achievements.displayName: Take out two Splitter spawns with a single shot.
achievements.description: You took out two Splitter spawns with a single shot.
achievements.sortReason: Use the first convenient Splitter during Act 2.
achievements.summary: In @loc{Act 2: Setback}, split the first Splitter into four small spawns and kill two with one shotgun blast.

guide.context: The convenient Splitter appears near the train tracks during the objective to find rewriting objects. Reloading the checkpoint provides another attempt if the blast catches only one spawn.

steps.text: During @loc{Act 2: Setback}, follow the rewriting-object objective near the train tracks until the first @enemy{Splitter} emerges from a building doorway.
Boost the @item{flashlight} on the Splitter until its original body divides into two, then continue burning away the darkness until those bodies divide into four small spawns.
Back away and position the small spawns so at least two overlap within one @item{shotgun} blast.
Kill two small Splitter spawns with the same shotgun shot; reload the checkpoint and repeat the setup if only one dies.

achievements.displayName: Find all of the manuscript pages.
achievements.description: You got every manuscript page in the game.
achievements.sortReason: Follow the chronological route during the campaign; replay chapters for cleanup.
achievements.summary: Collect all 53 @item{manuscript pages} across the Motel, Observatory, and Drive-In chapters in all three acts.

guide.context: The counters under Collectibles > Manuscript Pages track 21 Motel pages, 16 Observatory pages, and 16 Drive-In pages. Each act changes the available pages, and completed chapters can be replayed for cleanup.

steps.text: In @loc{Act 1, The Mechanic}, collect @item{Alan Wake, the Writer} immediately beyond the first two Taken after obtaining the flashlight and gun.
After escaping to the light at the Motel entrance, turn left toward the gas station and parked trucks, climb onto the rearmost truck, and collect @item{The Splitter} from the nearby rock.
Return to the gas pumps, walk toward the caravan with the television, and take @item{Pages and Instincts} from the fence on the left before reaching the caravan.
Return to the main road, walk away from the Motel toward the yellow jeep and railway, and collect @item{The Devil Is in the Details} from the right-side fence just beyond the rails.
Pass between the station-like building and large railcar, enter the yard, turn right toward the distant oil pumps, and collect @item{Rewriting Reality} from the rock beside the fence.
Return to the Motel compound, head toward the Diner, and divert to the large oil rig on the right to collect @item{Hunting Mr. Scratch}.
Enter the Diner's backyard from the building's left side and take @item{Too Many Legs} from the rock.
Speak with @npc{Emma} in the Motel garage during the story to receive @item{New Reality: The Satellite}.
After receiving the Diner keys and finding the Motel keys inside, enter the Motel room beside the courtyard radio to collect @item{The Twisted Mirror}.
In @loc{Act 1, The Scientist}, enter the observatory gate and collect @item{Success} from the front of the fire truck.
Follow the rising road to the Deliveries building and collect @item{The Genesis of Mr. Scratch} beside its left-hand door.
Continue to the main observatory entrance and take @item{The Spiders} from the left side of the white container.
Take the downhill road to the smaller observatory and collect @item{Fighting the Taken} from the concrete island in its small parking area.
Return to the main observatory entrance, move around its left side, and collect @item{Pressure} from the rock.
Complete the required objectives in @loc{Act 1, The Scientist} to receive the story-awarded page @item{New Reality: Fragment 1}.
In @loc{Act 1, The Curator}, turn around at the start, return to the large theater sign shown in the opening scene, and collect @item{The Grenadier} from its base.
Reach the objective building without entering, circle around its left side, and collect @item{Bright Falls} near the dumpster behind it.
After the parking-area scene, remain outside the lot, follow the short wall on the right to the overturned car with flashing lights, and collect @item{A Car in Flight} from the rock ahead.
From the parking-area entrance, face the safe haven and take @item{What Really Matters} from the open trunk of the orange car with flashing lights on its left.
Pass through the generator-building gate, follow the road to the rear, and collect @item{Alice} inside the safe-haven shack.
In @loc{Act 2, Setback}, collect @item{The Spectre} directly ahead when the chapter returns Alan to the canyon.
After the narrow passage, collect @item{The Appearance of Mr. Scratch} beneath the shack on the right where music played earlier.
Before reaching the Motel, find the shack containing a truck, shotgun, and ammunition, then collect @item{My Best Friend} from the shack's left side.
Approach the Diner and collect @item{Emma Sloan} from the table beside its entrance.
Run toward the gas pumps and caravan, then collect @item{Night Springs, the Cult TV Show} from the front section of the dismantled bus on the caravan's right.
After speaking with Emma, reach the railroad, turn right, and collect @item{Night Springs, Arizona} from the low fence beside the railcar and large ruined sign.
After the scene that sends Alan back to the Motel rooms, go first to the road-facing room near the ice machine, identified by an objective star, and collect @item{Wake's Friends}.
In @loc{Act 2, Progress}, pass through the gate, enter the fenced area on the left with three huge cylinders, and collect @item{Dr. Meadows} between the two cylinders on the right.
Return uphill to the Deliveries building and collect @item{Cosmological Truths} from the wooden box on the right immediately after entering its area.
Continue through the nearby open gate toward the objective car and carefully approach @item{The Darkness} beyond the broken fence at the edge.
At the main observatory entrance, enter the white truck containing the carbine and ammunition to collect @item{The Nature of Stories}.
From the main observatory entrance, go around the building's right side and collect @item{The Taken} from the boxes.
Descend to the smaller observatory, stay on its right side in the pipe area, and collect @item{Lost in the Dark Place} from the rock beyond the pipes.
Complete the required objectives in @loc{Act 2, Progress} to receive the story-awarded page @item{New Reality: Fragment 2}.
In @loc{Act 2, Relapse}, follow the objective to its building but remain outside, then collect @item{The Dangers of Creation} immediately left of the stairs.
Head toward the parking lot, turn right through the small safe-haven parking area, continue to the Souvenirs shop, and collect @item{Equilibrium} from the wooden overlook railing on its left.
Descend into the main parking area and collect @item{The Doppelganger} from the base of the theater screen.
From the safe haven beside the small concrete television building, travel straight south beyond the Projectors building and collect @item{The Plan} from the rocks on the right.
Continue southwest toward the old windmill, enter the derelict shed near the cliff edge and projection booth, and collect @item{Mr. Scratch's Trap} inside.
Enter the generator-building gate, move left as far as possible, turn right, and collect @item{Survival in the Dark Place} from the small table.
After entering the generator building, turn right instead of left toward the switches and collect @item{Serena Valdivia}.
In @loc{Act 3, Resolved}, look left when the new enemy appears in the canyon and collect @item{Old Gods of Asgard} from the piece of wood.
Reach the main road, turn right, stay on its right side, then turn right again at the Diner and oil rig and follow the uphill gate to collect @item{Barry and The Old Gods} from the pole.
Return to the Motel and collect @item{Old Gods In The Studio} directly below the large Motel sign.
Enter the Motel's inner garage courtyard, walk south past the radio table, climb the stairs to the pool, and collect @item{The Giant} from a table.
Return to the caravan and collect @item{Emma and Mr. Scratch} beside it.
In @loc{Act 3, Completed}, pass through the gate, take the left road toward the smaller observatory, and collect @item{Everything Is As Real As Everything Else} on the right before the parking area.
From the main observatory entrance, descend the right-hand road toward Deliveries and collect @item{Dr. Meadows and Mr. Scratch} behind the sign a short distance down.
Complete the required objectives in @loc{Act 3, Completed} to receive the story-awarded page @item{New Reality}.
In @loc{Act 3, United}, restore power, return to the parking lot, continue forward instead of climbing the concrete stairs, and collect @item{Serena and Mr. Scratch} from the rock.
Climb those concrete stairs to the safe haven beside the small television building and collect @item{Focusing The Beam} next to the television.

Before advancing the objective, return to the Drive-In entrance, stop before the ticket booths, turn left toward the yellow car with flashing lights, enter the dirt, turn left again, and climb to @item{Alice's Film} on the rock.
Leave the Drive-In through the ticket booths, turn right, continue forward, and look right to collect @item{The Clothes} from a cactus.

achievements.sortReason: Leave cumulative kill cleanup until every campaign and Arcade objective is complete.
achievements.summary: Defeat 2,000 @enemy{Taken} cumulatively across the campaign and Arcade Mode.

guide.context: Campaign and Arcade kills both reduce the remaining total, so finish the other objectives before deliberately farming whatever count is left.

steps.text: Complete the full campaign, all Arcade star targets, and both Arcade score challenges before beginning dedicated kill cleanup.
If the achievement remains locked, replay @loc{Act 2: Setback} and advance to the mine encounter containing spider Taken and a nearby enemy pack.
Kill the spiders and the surrounding @enemy{Taken}, reload the checkpoint, and repeat the encounter until the cumulative total reaches 2,000.
